summary: As an operations person onboarding WhatsApp Business Accounts, I find the verification process frustrating but not critical enough to pay for a dedicated tool. Free workarounds (community checklists, BSP support) already reduce the pain, and I'm skeptical that a SaaS can truly provide specific rejection feedback given Meta's opaque system. I would only consider buying if the price is very low and it demonstrably cuts weeks of delays.
strongest_points: If the tool could actually predict rejection reasons before submission, it would save me days of trial-and-error resubmissions.
A clear, step-by-step guide tailored to my business type would reduce anxiety and speed up onboarding.
If it integrates directly with Meta's portal and automates document checks, it could replace my manual checklist and support tickets.
weaknesses: I already get free support from my BSP (Twilio, WATI, etc.) and community forums — why pay extra?
I doubt a third-party tool can access Meta's internal rejection logic; it might just be a fancy checklist that I can replicate with a spreadsheet.
The economic impact of delays is moderate (score 2/5), so I'm not willing to spend more than $10–20/month per account.
